summary: Full e2e test of Krushi Raksha (backend + frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS against public URL (health, live-weather dashboard with seeded Soybean crop + risks, diary create/get/422, Marathi assistant via Gemini with history persistence, diagnosis multipart 200/415/422, land-records 5 steps + log-download). Frontend: home renders with live temp (22.1C), all 4 quick actions, crop watch, risk card, EN<->MR toggle across screens, all 4 bottom-nav tabs, full diary create flow (toast, timeline, expense total update, persistence after reload), diagnosis modal render + no-photo validation toast, 7/12 modal with 5 steps + official portal handoff in new tab without crash, assistant Gemini reply works (~3s) and history persists. ONE CRITICAL UI BUG: assistant chat composer (input + send button) is fully hidden behind the absolute-positioned glass bottom nav - send button is NOT tappable by real users (taps land on nav-tab-diary instead).

minor.issue: No DELETE endpoint for diary entries, so TEST_-prefixed entries accumulate; also no ownership scoping (known backlog item)

ui_bugs.issue: assistant-input (y 597-655) and assistant-send-button (y 607-655) are entirely covered by the floating BottomNav (top y=592, position:absolute, minHeight 75). Send button is not tappable; Playwright's non-force click times out with 'bottom-nav subtree intercepts pointer events', and force clicks at the send-button coordinates hit nav-tab-diary, switching tabs. AssistantScreen lacks bottom padding to clear the nav (HomeScreen scrollContent has paddingBottom:128 but the composer is outside the ScrollView). Verified on 375x667 web preview; same absolute-overlay structure affects native. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:553-567 (chatComposer) and bottomNav style at index.tsx:950
chatContent paddingBottom is only 20, so the latest message bubbles are obscured by the floating bottom nav (75px). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:950 (chatContent)
Gemini replies contain markdown (**bold**, numbered lists) which is rendered as raw asterisks in Text. Minor UX issue.

issues: Entry meta line shows English activity_type ('Soybean - irrigation - Rs500') even in Marathi mode - not localized
BlurView does not blur on web preview (expected platform limitation), showing translucent smudges over content behind nav - acceptable

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (weatherCard uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:950

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix assistant composer being hidden under the floating bottom nav - add bottom padding/margin of at least nav height (75px + bottom inset) to the chat composer (e.g. paddingBottom on chatComposer or marginBottom equal to bottom nav height), and increase chatContent paddingBottom similarly so last messages are visible
Localize diary timeline meta (activity_type) for Marathi mode
Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow to clear web console warning
Optional: strip/render markdown in assistant bubbles (Gemini returns ** markdown)
Code health: split app/index.tsx (951 lines > 700 guideline) into per-screen components
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx is 951 lines with 8+ screen/modal components - exceeds 700-line guideline, should be split into src/components/*
Backend: data integrity approach is sound - unique id indexes, single-document atomic inserts, _id excluded from all responses, timezone-aware UTC datetimes
Backend: assistant/diagnosis create fresh LlmChat session per request (no conversational memory) - acceptable for current scope
Frontend: loadDashboard is memoized over stale language closure for the GPS-blocked toast text (minor, toast may show in previous language)

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows pass except assistant composer tappability)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed diary entries (TEST_Irrigated north plot x2 via API, TEST_Urea purchase e2e via UI) and assistant/diagnosis records via API tests. No DELETE endpoint exists, so they persist; prefixed TEST_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (12/12) via /app/backend/tests/test_krushi_raksha_api.py - reuse for regression. Known CRITICAL bug: assistant-send-button/assistant-input hidden under floating bottom nav (nav top y=592 on 375x667); use JS dispatchEvent click to functionally test assistant until fixed. Diary modal clicks need ~1.5s wait after open for slide animation or clicks fail 'element outside viewport'. Assistant history is seeded with prior test messages, so suggestion chips (assistant-suggestion-*) only render when history is empty. Gemini replies in ~3-8s. Photo upload for diagnosis cannot be tested on web preview (native only).
rca_of_issue: Assistant send button not tappable. Repro: open Ask tab, type message, tap send -> nothing happens (tap intercepted by bottom nav). RCA: BottomNav is position:absolute at bottom (minHeight 75) rendered as sibling AFTER content in app-root; AssistantScreen's KeyboardAvoidingView flex container extends to screen bottom with no bottom padding, so chatComposer (height ~70) sits entirely within the nav's hit area. BlurView is transparent so users cannot see the composer either. Mitigation: give chatComposer marginBottom/paddingBottom >= 75 + bottom inset, or render BottomNav in normal flow; also increase chatContent paddingBottom from 20.
